description: Prepaid booking with deposit, check-in/no-show handling, dispute windows, an accredited arbiter and chargeback-style defaults when the arbiter misses its ruling deadline (hotel stay escrow)

settle.agreed.description: Guest and hotel agree on how to split the money; the co-signer checks it against the policy.

refund.conceded.description: The hotel admits a problem at check-in; everything goes back to the guest.

settle.ruling.description: The arbiter rules on a dispute and signs with one party. The co-signer is not involved.

default.refund.description: The hotel never confirmed in time: the guest gets the room money back automatically, with anything else in the account.

default.noshow.description: The guest never checked in and never disputed: the hotel is paid the room automatically, and anything else in the account goes back to the guest.

default.noshowSweep.description: The same no-show, signed a second time for when the account holds more than the room price (say a partial deposit and a refused check-in): the hotel is paid the room and the extra goes back to the guest. The co-signer completes whichever version fits the money in the account.

default.release.description: Nobody claimed or disputed after checkout: the room goes to the hotel and the deposit (plus anything extra) back to the guest, automatically.

default.chargebackEntry.description: You disputed a problem on arrival (no room, wrong room) and the arbiter missed its deadline: like a card chargeback, you get a full refund of the room, any deposit and the dispute bond, automatically.

default.chargebackClaim.description: You disputed the hotel's claim against your deposit (or the stay, after checkout or in its last night) and the arbiter missed its deadline: the claim is rejected. The hotel gets the room (less the fee); your deposit and the dispute bond come back to you, automatically.

default.chargebackStay.description: You disputed the stay mid-stay and the arbiter missed its deadline: the nights after the one you disputed in are refunded. The hotel gets the nights up to and including the night you disputed in (less the fee); the remaining nights, your deposit and the dispute bond come back to you, automatically. Signed once per night; stays over 14 nights have no such ending and wait for the arbiter.

confirmBy.description: The hotel must confirm the booking within this time after you book.

checkInBy.description: The latest the hotel can record you as checked in, counted from the check-in time.

entryDisputeBy.description: How long you have, from the check-in time, to dispute a problem on arrival (no room, wrong room).

claimBy.description: How long the hotel has after checkout to claim against your deposit.

disputeWindowEnds.description: How long you have after checkout to dispute a claim or a problem with the stay. After this, silence counts as agreement.

rulingDueBy.description: How long the arbiter has to rule once a dispute is open. If it misses this deadline, the chargeback-style default for your dispute applies: the money in dispute comes back to you.
